content: ESP32 OTA: ArduinoOTA.begin() starts UDP discovery on port 3232. ArduinoOTA.handle() in loop() handles incoming OTA push (from PlatformIO 'pio run -t upload --upload-port hostname'). WiFiManager (tzapu): wm.autoConnect('TextReader-Setup') — if no saved creds, starts AP + portal; if saved, connects immediately. NVS: Preferences prefs; prefs.begin('wifi', false); prefs.putString('ssid', ssid); prefs.getString('ssid', ''). ArduinoOTA conflicts known with ESPAsyncWebServer; with ArduinoWebsockets (non-async) coexistence is generally stable. OTA trigger via WS: parse 'command':'ota' field, call ArduinoOTA restart or HTTPUpdate.
